mission.title: Spiral
mission.description: Investigate a break-in for signs of Zionite involvement, then hit Zion's broadcast signal control center.

npc.say: If you really want to help, how about putting money into education instead of...of more guns and bombs? What are those doing for anyone?

Do you think this is a big bust? Was it something on our computer--secret codes or something? I haven't been able to sleep just thinking about it! I keep seeing numbers in my head...
Oh! What if they, like, planted a code in my head, and hypnotized me into forgetting it until they release it with a secret command? I saw that on TV once. Wow!
Hey, you wouldn't happen to have a spare coffee filter on you, would you?
Just sweeping up. I'm not in your way, am I?

phase.briefing:
{player}, our effort to neutralize Zion's aggression goes well. However, we must not underestimate the damage they can cause as they become increasingly desperate. Every possible precaution must be taken.
Police reports indicate a suspicious break-in at a nearby apartment. It is your task to search the area thoroughly for signs of Zionite involvement.

enter.say: That's the apartment complex. The police report says there are three witnesses in the apartment that was robbed.

talk.say: Some creeps dressed in leather--like we told the cops--just went right out with our computer. One of them shouted something about a "blue pill" when Gertha nailed him with a shoe. I'd say they were on drugs; probably traded our computer for a quick hit.
They were, like, tall, and really mean-looking. Arnita Gajan was afraid, but not me. One of them was kind of cute, but not really my type. I think they might have been sailors, or...hm...smugglers!

done.say:
Scanning...
Nah, nothing there. Uh... The ID in there says it belongs to Arnita Gajan. You'd better give it back.

objective.text: Give the ID to Arnita Gajan

done.say: You know what? I say we just put all that down in our report, and let the Agents bust their heads over it. I guess it could have been Zionites, but I don't know if I'd call those three reliable witnesses, exactly.

phase.briefing:
I...see. It suggests a possibility of desperate Zion operatives scavenging computer parts. I will flag this case for further investigation.
At this time, however, I have a more pressing assignment for you. Viral routines planted in Zion's network have revealed the location of their broadcast signal control center. The destruction of this center, and its database, will severely impair Zion's ability to coordinate their operatives when jacked into the Matrix. You are to eliminate all resistance, and confiscate any available data.

enter.say: I'm reading lots of redpills in there, and a networked computer system.

done.say: That's it for the hostiles in the area.

Someone just cleaned the net log off that system. They wouldn't do that unless they were trying to cover their tracks after sending some data...and since I don't see the broadcast database we were looking for in there, I'm gonna go ahead and guess that they transferred it somewhere else just before you got there. We'll have to see if Gray can pull some record of the transaction.

phase.briefing:
Report received. A backtrack scan is running...
Yes. The data was transferred to a previously unmapped system, not far from your present location.

enter.say: Let's see what we've got there... A computer...and a couple bluepills. No hostiles in sight.

near.say: Okay...logic--I can solve this logically. Now, if I was a coffee filter, where would I be?

done.say: That's the system Gray was talking about, but there's nothing on it.

complete.say: All right, there's no data there, and it sounds like Zion's already been through. We're gonna need Gray to get another scan run.

phase.briefing: Operative, one of our Agents sent to shut down a newly detected unregistered network uplink has abruptly ceased function. Subprograms in the area returned feedback indicating the presence of Zionite hostiles before they were terminated. That this has taken place simultaneously with your pursuit of the missing broadcast data is unlikely to be mere coincidence. You are being routed to the uplink to investigate further.

enter.say: I'm reading some carnage in there: dead programs, redpills--heck, even a dead terminal.

You're getting close to that dead system.
Hm, speaking of dead...

complete.say:
Ho-kay. One dead Agent, plus one dead illegal uplink terminal, plus one batch of missing network data... I'd say this is adding up to Zion managing to smuggle that broadcast control database out from under our noses.
But what the heck took out that Agent?

mission.finish:
The failure to capture Zion's broadcast control data is...unfortunate. However, the destruction of their control center will impair the efficiency of their operative signal capabilities, even if we assume that they bring a backup system online.
The sudden termination of the Special Agent assigned to investigate Zion's emergency data uplink suggests the interference of a powerful third party. The list of suspects capable of such an action is a short one. This will be investigated. It serves to remind us, {player}, that the longer a chaotic situation is allowed to persist, the less predictable will be its consequences. This is why we must work to bring a quick resolution to the present conflict.
